previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation and lem-maincb-reset-output-typing to the same eligible scalar raw call: the former supplies the improved map and its two bounds while preserving bijectivity, and the latter supplies its extended-inclusion typing and hence its extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism typing because u_0 is bijective. The output has unchanged source M_1 and target A_{U_1}, satisfies d_{U_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1} and ||v_{U_1}(I_{M_1})-u_{A_{U_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}, and these fields and the isomorphism tag form the required def-maincb-reset-state datum.
new_statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-output-typing, by itself, to the eligible scalar raw call of node 1.2.2.1 with D=D_*, target ambient defect epsilon_R=epsilon_{U_1}=W.L*epsilon, and base scale t=t_atom. Select the single witness v_{U_1} furnished by that lemma. Its conclusion simultaneously gives d_{U_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}, ||v_{U_1}(I_{M_1})-u_{A_{U_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}, unchanged source M_1, target A_{U_1}, and amplification family, and extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism typing because the raw map u_0 is bijective. Together with the recorded field epsilon_{U_1}, these data form the required def-maincb-reset-state datum.
